newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tata Chem plunges 8 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India Tata Chem plunges 8 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Tata Chemicals Ltd opened 16 rupees or 8.0 percent lower at 184 rupees on the Bombay bourse after the firm's first half results fell below market expectations, traders said.
Tata Chemicals said its net profit during the six months to September 30, 1996 fell to 1,319.9 million rupees from 1,751.5 a year ago.
Provision for taxation during the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) was sharply higher at 447.8 million rupees from 30.0 million in the corresponding period last year.
